name: 33065 · Coral Springs, FL
findings: ZIP 33065 (Coral Springs) has 175 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33065 (Coral Springs) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33065 (Coral Springs) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 59 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 24 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
